translations.web: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.
translations.bsb: The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds through the whole land of Cush.
translations.kjv: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Ethiopia.
translations.asv: And the name of the second river is Gihon: the same is it that compasseth the whole land of Cush.
